verdicts.reason: A: the two badges are split up (FREE DELIVERY pinned at the top over a leftover sliver of the circle, 4 FLAVOURS floating alone between the copy and the can), and the Order Now button nearly touches both side edges. Still, the can is a good size and the top-to-bottom order reads well. B: both badges are crammed against the top edge on top of the circle sliver and compete with the headline above it. The can has shrunk to a small, unimportant object, with big empty gaps above and below it, so the column feels hollow and loses the original's product focus.
